question: At host display 1080x2340, does unchanged Frozen Bubble on the normal UIKit CADisplayLink path draw a Bitmap into the SurfaceView content Surface and post a changed buffer, or does it reproduce the physical lock/post path with draw_bitmap_count 0?
current_uncertainty: Linux at 1080x2340 with APK sha256 57f4735297befc68c0a7aa6cd9e442ecd250b1b2b38104324a12b6c2d4e18569 draws and changes the buffer. The physical iPhone at the same size posted 119 times with draw_bitmap_count 0 and an unchanged hash. The Simulator UIKit path has not been run at this host display.

expected_outcome_a.result: harness_called_do_traversal false, harness_called_render_api false, display 1080x2340, surfaceCreated 1, surfaceChanged 1, lock_count > 0, draw_bitmap_count > 0, pixel_change_count > 0, post_count > 0, and the posted buffer hash differs from the pre-draw hash
excludes: an iOS Runtime failure at the physical 1080x2340 scale
treating Bitmap decode as proof that Bitmap.createScaledBitmap ran at this size

expected_outcome_b.result: the UIKit path locks and posts the 1080x2340 content Surface with draw_bitmap_count 0 or an unchanged buffer hash
excludes: treating the Linux 1080x2340 draw as the iOS result
guessing a presentation or unresolved-API fix before the Simulator draw path is observed

why_cheaper_test_is_insufficient: The Linux 1080x2340 probe already draws. It does not execute UIKit CADisplayLink or the iOS Simulator bitmap link. The physical device at that size posted without a draw, so the remaining automated discriminator is the Simulator host display set to 1080x2340.
